summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of the 2gether app. Backend: 15/15 pytest tests passed against public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (couples create/join/me, messages, moods, worries + comments, register-push validation & non-blocking failure). Frontend UI (mobile viewport 390x844): the user's original complaint (Invalid URL / cannot log in) is FIXED — onboarding loads, 'Create our space' successfully calls POST /api/couples/create, navigates into (tabs), invite-card shows the 6-char code (NVEUIK); Set-mood sheet opens; navigation to Chat/Gallery/Worries works; join-with-code flow (in a fresh storage) pairs the two users (invite-card disappears, partner name appears); session persists across page reload (SecureStore.g2g_user_id -> X-User-Id header); empty-name is rejected client-side with a toast. No React Native red screens or deprecated packages (no expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner, or expo-background-fetch).

integration_issues.flow: Cold load on a deep route (e.g., /chat) after refresh
integration_issues.issue: Two transient 401 responses on the very first render after reload: react-query fires /api/couples/me and /api/messages before AuthProvider's useEffect finishes reading SecureStore and calling setAuthUserId. The UI still recovers on the next tick (queries refetch on window focus / user tap), and the session IS persisted, but the 401s show in the console. Consider gating <Slot/> in the root _layout on `useAuth().ready` so children don't mount before X-User-Id is applied.

react_native_issues.component: Some RN internal (likely react-native-web animated / gesture-handler)
react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Non-blocking, but should be tracked.

action_items: OPTIONAL: In app/_layout.tsx, wait for useAuth().ready before rendering the routed screen tree to avoid the two 401 flashes on cold-load-to-deep-link after reload.
OPTIONAL: Track the 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' RN warning (likely coming from a third-party lib; safe to ignore for now).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~620 lines and starting to mix routing + push + storage + models. Splitting into routers/ (couples, messages, moods, worries) + services/ (storage, push) would improve maintainability, though not blocking.
api.ts correctly uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL and never hardcodes URLs — good.
Auth model has no rotation/expiry (X-User-Id is a raw UUID kept in SecureStore forever). Acceptable for this display-name-only design but worth calling out.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create TEST_-prefixed couples/messages/worries/moods. UI test created two TEST_Play users paired via code NVEUIK. Not cleaned up (isolated preview DB).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All primary features working. If retesting, use EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env for the API base and mobile viewport 390x844 for the web preview. testIDs available on onboarding: mode-create, mode-join, name-input, code-input, onboarding-submit. On home: invite-card, couple-code, share-code-btn, set-mood-btn, mood-card-me, mood-card-partner, quick-chat, quick-gallery, quick-worries, sign-out-btn.
rca_of_issue: Original user error 'Invalid URL: /api/couples/create' was a frontend BASE_URL misconfig in a previous workspace. In the ported repo, src/api.ts uses `process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL + '/api' + path` and .env has EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL set to the public preview host, so the URL now resolves correctly (verified: 200 on create + navigation into tabs).
